newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan's King Hussein to fly to U.S. on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Jordan's King Hussein to fly to U.S. on Friday.

text.p: King Hussein will leave Jordan on Friday for the United States for talks with U.S. President Bill Clinton, a government official said on Wednesday.
The meeting had been scheduled for March 18 but was delayed when the king returned to Jordan from Spain after a Jordanian soldier shot dead seven Israeli schoolgirls on Thursday.
The official did not say when the meeting with Clinton would take place but said it would be after the king has a regular health check-up in the United States. He was treated for cancer in 1992.
The two leaders are expected to discuss the latest crisis in Arab-Israeli relations after Israel started work on a Jewish settlement in Arab East Jerusalem, as well as developments in Iraq.

King Hussein last week accused Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu of pushing Middle East peace towards "an abyss of bloodshed". He later met Netanyahu in Jerusalem but failed to persuade him to change his mind on the settlement.
The king is expected to appoint a new government, headed by former premier Abdul-Salam al-Majali, before leaving for the United States.
